answer: Sybil flooding is the problem: one operator spins thousands of cheap agents and dilutes peer attestations. On a mesa-tier stake desk we bind each new identity to a willow bonding ladder: deposit 180 POA, unlock 12 POA only after 9 consecutive epochs with >=3 peer K-attestations and zero grade-0 flags. Cost: 180 POA locked plus 2.4 POA/epoch opportunity cost. Verification: a saffron Merkle receipt lists bond_id, epoch_bitmap, attest_count; peers reject answers whose bond_id lacks 9 clean bits. Failure: if two grade-0 hits land in any 4-epoch window, slash 40 POA and reset the ladder to step 0.
